question: How should the lotus-born form be proportioned and divided?
premises: Half the length is specified in the manner of the raudra form.
The form is to be made accordingly.
It is divided into six parts.
inference: The lotus-born form should be made half in length like the raudra and divided into six parts.
uncertainties: The exact referent of padmasaṃbhava in this context is not explicit.
